name: localdev-mcp
description: Connect ChatGPT Desktop to your self-hosted Windows LocalDev MCP server to discover local developer SDKs, inspect and edit authorized projects, and run approved builds and tests.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, edit, build, and test authorized local Windows projects
interface.longDescription: LocalDev MCP connects ChatGPT Desktop to your self-hosted Windows LocalDev MCP server (127.0.0.1:8765/mcp) with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, automatic runtime discovery (Node.js, Python, PHP/Laravel, Flutter/Dart, Android SDK, Godot, Git, Go, GCC), scoped project access, direct file editing/creation, background jobs, and local security approvals.
defaultPrompt: List my detected local development environments and registered projects.
Inspect my registered project and run its test suite.
